text: Separate aim status-transition time from relevance-review time
description: Preserve status.date as the time the status state actually changed; editing only the status comment must not refresh it. Add optional status.reviewedAt for an explicit human/agent confirmation that the current intention and status still hold. Stale status age is a review signal only, never automatic deprecation; central standing aims may remain valid indefinitely. Expose reviewedAt through backend and MCP update paths, with focused compatibility tests for legacy aims.
reflection: Relevance audit found the requested behavior already implemented (introduced in commit 4c495b4): AimStatusSchema makes reviewedAt optional for legacy compatibility; backend aim.update preserves status.date for comment/same-state review changes and advances it only on state transition; MCP create/update schemas expose reviewedAt; and the focused MCP test verifies explicit review on creation, same-state review preserving transition time, and later transitions preserving reviewedAt. Fresh verification on 2026-07-29: packages/mcp/src/__tests__/tools-aims.test.ts passed 13/13, including 'status date changes only on state transition; reviewedAt is independent'.

status.comment: Already implemented and freshly verified; stale open status corrected to review pending user acceptance.
